title_youtube: Splitting the Check Won't Save You From a Bull Moose
description_youtube:
Splitting the check won't save you from a bull moose. The diner-etiquette test, settled by a 1,600 pound animal.

The useless facts:
- A bull moose can weigh up to about 1,600 pounds, according to the Alaska Department of Fish and Game.
- Moose can run up to 35 miles per hour.
- Splitting it to the cent is still the right thing to do. The moose agrees: it tipped.

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. Which friend are you: the calculator or the one who forgot his wallet?

Sources:
- Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Moose species profile (adult males 1,200 to 1,600 lb): https://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=moose.main
- Alaska Department of Fish and Game, Moose (can run up to 35 mph): https://www.adfg.alaska.gov/index.cfm?adfg=moose.printerfriendly
